step.name: Ambil data DW
step.sql: SELECT d.year, c.country, t.genre_name, ROUND(SUM(f.amount)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue, SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units_sold, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sk_customer) AS customer_count, ROUND((100.0 * SUM(f.amount) / SUM(SUM(f.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, c.country))::numeric, 2) AS pct_of_country_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, c.country ORDER BY SUM(f.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM fact_table.fact_sales f JOIN dimension.dim_date d ON d.sk_date = f.sk_date JOIN dimension.dim_customer c ON c.sk_customer = f.sk_customer JOIN dimension.dim_track t ON t.sk_track = f.sk_track GROUP BY d.year, c.country, t.genre_name ORDER BY d.year, c.country, revenue_rank

notepad.note: 1. Membuat Suroggate Key (sk) customer 2. Standarisasi nama State di dim customer, seperti TX --> Texas 3. Handling Missing value, di kolom company dan state 4. Penggabungan First name dan Last name customer 5. Penerapan SCD Type 2

step.name: staging_customer
step.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, -- Penggabungan first_name dan last_name CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS customer_name, -- Handling missing values COALESCE(c.company, 'No Company') AS company, c.city, CASE c.state -- Standarisasi nama state dari singkatan ke nama lengkap WHEN 'SP' THEN 'São Paulo' WHEN 'RJ' THEN 'Rio de Janeiro' WHEN 'DF' THEN 'District Federal' WHEN 'WA' THEN 'Washington' WHEN 'CA' THEN 'California' WHEN 'NY' THEN 'New York' WHEN 'FL' THEN 'Florida' WHEN 'IL' THEN 'Illinois' WHEN 'TX' THEN 'Texas' WHEN 'AZ' THEN 'Arizona' WHEN 'ON' THEN 'Ontario' WHEN 'BC' THEN 'British Columbia' WHEN 'AB' THEN 'Alberta' WHEN 'VV' THEN 'Värmland' WHEN 'NSW' THEN 'New South Wales' WHEN 'RM' THEN 'Región Metropolitana' WHEN 'NT' THEN 'Northern Territory' WHEN 'MB' THEN 'Manitoba' WHEN 'NS' THEN 'Nova Scotia' WHEN 'MA' THEN 'Massachusetts' WHEN 'UT' THEN 'Utah' WHEN 'MV' THEN 'Montevideo' WHEN 'WI' THEN 'Wisconsin' WHEN 'QC' THEN 'Quebec' WHEN 'NV' THEN 'Nevada' ELSE COALESCE(c.state, 'N/A') END AS state, c.country, c.email FROM staging.customer c;

notepad.note: pada dim_date, diperoleh dari turunan table invoice, dengan memecah timestamp pada timestamp pada invoice_date menjadi kolom turunan independen (Tahun, Kuartal, Bulan, Hari, Weekday/Weekend) yang digunakan untuk memfasilitasi analisis tren time-series dan efek musiman.
penggunaan DISTINCT berakibat pada penghapusan duplikasi tanggal transaksi sehingga memungkinkan jika jumlah baris di dim_date dengan jumlah baris di table invoice berbeda

step.name: staging_date_from_invoice_table
step.sql: SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'YYYYMMDD')::INT AS sk_date, invoice_date::DATE AS full_date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::INT AS year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM invoice_date)::INT AS quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date)::INT AS month, EXTRACT(DAY FROM invoice_date)::INT AS day, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM invoice_date) IN (6, 7) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type FROM staging.invoice ORDER BY sk_date;

notepad.note: Menggabungkan First Name dan Last Name employee membuat sk_employee

step.name: staging_employee
step.sql: SELECT e.employee_id, CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS employee_name, e.title, e.city, e.country FROM staging.employee e;

notepad.note: Mengubah milliseconds di tabel track menjadi kategori durasi lagu (Pendek, Standar, Epik) menggabungkan table track, genre, album, artist, media type Penerapan SCD Type 1

step.name: staging_track
step.sql: SELECT t.track_id, t."name" AS track_name, al.title AS album_title, ar."name" AS artist_name, g."name" AS genre_name, m."name" AS media_type_name, t.composer, t.unit_price, CASE WHEN t.milliseconds < 180000 THEN 'Pendek' -- < 3 menit WHEN t.milliseconds BETWEEN 180000 AND 300000 THEN 'Standar' -- 3-5 menit ELSE 'Epik' -- > 5 menit END AS duration_category FROM staging.track t LEFT JOIN staging.album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id LEFT JOIN staging.artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id LEFT JOIN staging.genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id LEFT JOIN staging.media_type m ON t.media_type_id = m.media_type_id;

step.name: Table input
step.sql: SELECT il.invoice_line_id, il.invoice_id, il.track_id, il.unit_price, il.quantity, i.customer_id, i.invoice_date, c.support_rep_id FROM staging.invoice_line il JOIN staging.invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN staging.customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id

notepad.note: 1. koneksi oltp hanya mengambil table yang ada di schema public. hanya butuh kolom table name. 2. koneksi ke staging(untuk list table masuk).hanya butuh kolom table name 3. gabungkan untuk mengecek tabel mana yang sudah masuk ke staging dari oltp menggunakan merge join. pake full outer karena untuk mendeteksi apakah ada yang null, selain outer ada resiko ketika tidak cocok maka akan hilang saat di join 4. get system info menunjukkan timestamp table ke input, tapi hanya menghasilkan 1 baris hasil, agar bisa terimplementasi ke semua baris, pakai join rows cartesian product 5. join rows cartesian product tidak perlu diotak atik 6. copy rows to result mengirim hasil ke tahap selanjutnya

step.name: log_oltp
step.sql: select '${table_name}' as table_name, count(*) as source_records, now() as source_date, '${mulai}' as etl_date_start from public.${table_name}

step.name: oltp_tabel_masuk
step.sql: select '${table_name}' as table_name, now() as input_date

entry.name: target
entry.sql: update log.staging_log set target_records = (select count(*) from staging.${table_name}), target_date = now() where table_name = '${table_name}'

entry.name: logical
entry.sql: update log.staging_log set logical = case when source_records = target_records then 'succes' else 'to be evaluated' end where table_name = '${table_name}'

notepad.note:
transformasi ini dimana data dipindahkan
logical: berfungsi untuk menghitung antara source record dan target record, jika jumlahnya sama maka succes, jika tidak sama harus dievaluasi
target: update target di table staging_log dengan penambahan kolom target records dan target_date

Kondisi: 1. Harus punya struktur tabel kosong di staging 2. Buat log tabel staging_log: a. table_name b. source_records (jumlah row yg ada di source/production) c. source_date (kapan data dibaca di source/production) d. target_records (jumlah row yg sudah masuk ke staging e. target_date (kapan data masuk ke staging f. etl_date_start (kapan pentaho/etl job di running) g. logical ->> if source records = target records : "Success" else "To be Evaluated" 3. Buat log_tabel_entry a. table_name b. input_date
